concept.hr: Šum pomiče primljene točke; prijamnik bira simbol po kvadrantu
concept.en: Noise moves the received points; the receiver picks the symbol by quadrant

summary.hr: Šesnaest QPSK simbola, po dva bita, prolazi kanal sa šumom: primljene točke, područja odluke, pogrešni simboli i bitovi uz Grayev kod.
summary.en: Sixteen QPSK symbols of two bits each cross a noisy channel: received points, decision regions, wrong symbols and wrong bits under a Gray code.

what.hr: Applet applet_qpsk.html (QPSK prijenos sa šumom u konstelacijskom dijagramu) i tekst odjeljka o PSK-u (50ohm.de, hrvatski prijevod)
what.en: The applet applet_qpsk.html (QPSK transmission with noise in a constellation diagram) and the text of the PSK section (50ohm.de, Croatian translation)

changes.hr: Prilagođen simdeck kitu kao simulacija po koracima (jedan simbol po koraku, 16 umjesto 32 simbola, ponovljiv slučajni niz), preveden na engleski, dodane odluke prijamnika, oznaka pogrešnih simbola i broj pogrešnih bitova
changes.en: Adapted to the simdeck kit as a stepper (one symbol per step, 16 instead of 32 symbols, a repeatable random sequence), translated into English, the receiver's decisions, marked wrong symbols and a count of wrong bits added
